findings.suggested_fix:
Translate the visible citation titles into French (preserving the <section>, <ol>, <li>, and <cite> tags and their order). For example: 
- <cite>Performance of ChatGPT on USMLE: Potential for AI-assisted medical education using large language models - PMC (nih.gov)</cite>
should become something like
- <cite>Performance de ChatGPT au USMLE : potentiel des grands modèles de langage pour l'enseignement médical assisté par IA - PMC (nih.gov)</cite>
Apply analogous literal but natural French translations to the other three <cite> entries, keeping the same links and HTML structure.
